create_CuMemAllocator_instance: create a CuMemAllocator singleton instance to manage CUDA memory pool with sleep mode support
use_CuMemAllocator_sleep: use CuMemAllocator to put allocator in sleep mode and offload tagged tensors to CPU memory
use_CuMemAllocator_wake_up: use CuMemAllocator to wake up from sleep mode and restore offloaded tensors back to GPU memory
use_CuMemAllocator_use_memory_pool: use CuMemAllocator context manager to allocate tensors in a tagged memory pool
use_use_memory_pool_with_allocator: use use_memory_pool_with_allocator context manager to get a memory pool and pluggable allocator
